newsitem.title: USA: Vernitron to change name, symbol Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Vernitron to change name, symbol Wednesday.

text.p: Vernitron Corp said Tuesday that beginning Wednesday it will change its name to Axsys Technologies Inc, and that its common stock will be quoted under the symbol "AXYS."

The company said it has completed acquiring Speedring Systems Inc, Speedring Inc and Lockheed Martin Beryllium Corp, an indirect subsidiary of Lockheed Martin Corp. It said it is changing its name to reflect its greater emphasis on designing and making systems for the precision optical scanning and positioning markets as a result if the acquisitions.
